body: **Foco:** Verbo-chave: give.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (comunicação intercultural).
**Texto do dia:** entrevista.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo entender e usar diferentes sentidos de give (give a talk, give way, give rise to, give up) em uma entrevista.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.intro: An etiquette consultant talks about gift-giving across cultures.
qa: Interviewer: Is **giving** a gift always polite?

Not always. In some countries it is customary to **give** a small present when you visit; in others, **giving** a gift in public may cause embarrassment. If a host **gives way** to your insistence, he may feel obliged to return the favour.

Do your research and **give** yourself time. Don’t **give in** to the urge to bring something expensive. And if the gift is refused, don’t **give up**: try again later, with a smaller gesture. Above all, **give** the other person room to say no.

items.q: Giving a gift in public is always polite.
The consultant advises bringing an expensive gift.
The consultant says to give the other person room to refuse.

blocks.body: **give** forma muitas combinações: observe o substantivo ou a partícula que vem depois.

items.s: She ___ a talk on etiquette yesterday. (give, past)
He gave ___ to pressure and agreed. (way)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Give someone the benefit of the doubt.** — Dar o benefício da dúvida.
**Give and take.** — Dar e receber; concessões.
**Give credit where credit is due.** — Dar crédito a quem merece.
**Give someone a hand.** — Dar uma mão.
**Give it a go.** — Tentar.
**Give somebody a wide berth.** — Manter distância de alguém.
**Give the green light.** — Dar sinal verde.
**Give rise to doubts.** — Dar origem a dúvidas.
**What if he refuses?** — E se ele recusar?
**Should I give a gift to my host?** — Devo dar um presente ao meu anfitrião?
**A small one is fine. Don’t give too much.** — Um pequeno serve. Não dê demais.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Ênfase intencional: a palavra mais importante da frase recebe o acento mais forte e a nota mais alta, para marcar contraste ou correção.
words: It was the POLICY, not the person.
We need MORE time, not more money.

prompts.q: Give advice about a first visit.
prompts.model: Give a small present and don’t insist.

prompts.q: Say what gives rise to misunderstanding.
prompts.model: Different customs give rise to misunderstanding.

prompts.q: Say when you gave a talk or a gift.
prompts.model: I gave a talk at school last year.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence advice paragraph using at least four meanings of give.
blocks.model: When you visit a new culture, give yourself time to observe. Give a small present, but give the host room to refuse. If he gives way to your insistence, he may feel obliged. Don’t give in to the urge to impress. Different customs can give rise to confusion, so don’t give up after one mistake.
checklist: Usei **give a talk / give way / give in / give up**

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
